source.author: verg
source.text: Nunc pateras libate Iovi precibusque vocate Anchisen genitorem, et vina reponite mensis.
source.text_original: Nunc pateras libate Iovi precibusque vocate / Anchisen genitorem, et vina reponite mensis.'
source.text_english: Now pour libations to Jupiter from the cups, and call upon Anchises, your father, with prayers, and set the wine back upon the tables.

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: an potest aliquis dubitare, quomodo religiones deorum sint institutae, cum apud Maronem legat Aeneae uerba sociis imperantis: nunc pateras libate Ioui precibusque uocate Anchisen genitorem ?
reuse.text_original: an potest aliquis dubitare, quomodo religiones deorum sint institutae, cum apud Maronem legat Aeneae uerba sociis imperantis: nunc pateras libate Ioui precibusque uocate Anchisen genitorem — ?
reuse.text_english: Or can anyone doubt how the religions of the gods were established, when in Vergil he reads Aeneas’ words as he gives orders to his companions: now pour libations from the cups to Jove and with prayers invoke Anchises your father?
